testcase.name: whitespace-only pages yield the notice rather than page separators
a 3-page pdf yields a note with three sections separated by the page break
blank pages retain their positions around extracted text and metadata
single-page pdf with a Title extracts text and titles the note from metadata
a scanned pdf with no text layer yields the notice body
an encrypted pdf yields the notice body, not an error
a malformed pdf yields the notice body and still stores the attachment
an uncompressed content stream still extracts text
a TJ kerning array extracts as one continuous word

two blank pages yield the notice while preserving metadata and attachment bytes
